messages.subject: Project Juniper - heads of terms (draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley,

Draft heads of terms attached. Key points: 4-year initial term from 1 June; mobilisation fee £420k; estimated Year 1 charges ~£3.91m p.a.; OTIF 99.0%; liability cap we've pitched at 125% to start. Paragraphs 10-12 (exclusivity to 31 May, NDA, governing law) are binding; the rest is subject to contract.

Grateful for any comments before we send to Castle & Vane.

Best,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
